Meta.title: Dien Chan 3D Face
Meta.description: Dien Chan stimulation routines on a 3D face

Home.title: Dien Chan, point by point, on a 3D face
Home.subtitle: Pick a routine, by pain or by condition. The face shows the point to stimulate and the timer counts for you.
Home.feature1Text: Rotate the head, zoom in, or jump between views with the buttons: front, profiles, back, top.
Home.feature2Text: Each routine runs through its points in order, labelled with their number on Bùi Quốc Châu's chart.
Home.feature3Text: A duration or a number of repetitions per point, pauses in between, a sound at the start and at the end.
Home.statement: The <red>red</red> point is the one to stimulate now. The <amber>orange</amber> point comes right after. You always know where to put your finger.
Home.detail1Text: When a point is stimulated on both sides, the timer runs the left side, then the right.
Home.detail2Text: Your phone does not go to sleep while a routine is running.
Home.detail3Text: Pause, previous step, next step: you stay in control at every moment.
Home.closeText: No sign-up. Open the face, pick a routine and start the timer.
Home.notice: Dien Chan is a complementary practice. It does not replace medical advice.
Home.demoPoint2: Right cheek, level with the nostril
Home.demoPoint4: Left cheek, level with the nostril

The 3D face model is "Male Head" by Alexander Antipov (Dessen), under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence (CC BY 4.0). It was modified: smoothed, recentred and rescaled.
Point numbering follows the chart of Bùi Quốc Châu, founder of Dien Chan.

sections.title: Health notice
body: Dien Chan is a complementary practice. The information on this site is given for guidance only: it is not a diagnosis, a treatment or medical advice.
It does not replace seeing a health professional. If in doubt, in case of lasting pain or in an emergency, see a doctor. Never stop a medical treatment without a doctor's advice.

The publisher cannot be held liable for an interruption of the site or for damage related to its use.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.description: Data collected, cookies used and visitors' rights.

sections.title: Data controller
body: The data controller is the publisher of the site {siteName}. Contact: {contactEmail}.

sections.title: Data collected
body: Browsing the site: no account is needed and no personal data is requested to explore the 3D face and follow a routine.
Account: if you have an account, your email address and your password are stored. The password is stored in encrypted form; the publisher cannot read it.
Technical data: like any site, the host keeps connection logs (IP address, date, page requested) to keep the service secure and running.

sections.title: Purposes
body: This data is only used to sign you in to your account, to show the site in your language and to keep it secure. It is never sold or used for advertising.

sections.title: Cookies and local storage
body: The site only uses cookies it needs to work:
— a session cookie, set only when you sign in to an account, to keep you signed in;
— a language cookie, set when you change language, to remember your choice;
— a note saved in your browser when you close the information banner, so that it is not shown again.
The site uses no advertising cookie and no audience measurement tool. This is why it does not ask for your consent: the law does not require it for strictly necessary cookies.

sections.title: Who receives the data
body: The data is processed by the publisher and its technical providers: {hostName} for hosting and {databaseName} for the database and sign-in.
These providers may process data outside the European Union. Such transfers are covered by the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.

sections.title: Retention
body: Account data is kept as long as the account exists, then deleted. Connection logs are kept by the host for the period set in its own terms.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can ask to access your data, to have it corrected, erased or exported, and ask to restrict the processing or object to it.
To exercise these rights, write to {contactEmail}. If you believe your rights are not respected, you can lodge a complaint with the French data protection authority, the CNIL (www.cnil.fr).

sections.title: Changes to this policy
body: This policy may be updated, for instance when the site changes. The date of the last update is shown at the top of the page.
